description: Example strain genotypes for the MVP demo. Each strain is a name plus a list of resistance mechanism ids from data/resistance_mechanisms.json. In a later iteration these would come from AMRFinderPlus/RGI run against an uploaded assembly instead of being hand-picked.

strains.source_note: No acquired resistance determinants; baseline for comparison.
Representative community-onset ESBL UTI isolate: CTX-M-15 plus efflux overexpression, the primary MDR uropathogen this MVP targets.

strains.display_name: ESBL + fluoroquinolone + co-trimoxazole resistant E. coli
strains.source_note: Common real-world MDR UTI phenotype: ESBL plus fluoroquinolone target mutation plus trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole target bypass, narrowing empiric oral options sharply.
Worst-case panel: carbapenemase plus ESBL plus efflux plus aminoglycoside pan-resistance -- the scenario where combination prioritisation matters most and where the fewest drugs remain fully active.
Narrower resistance profile isolating two target-bypass/inactivation mechanisms, useful for checking that unaffected drugs in the panel correctly stay fully active.
